claim: The effect survives matching candidate reduction AND entropy reduction; within-stratum gap = +0.6021 (n_rel=800, n_irr=1200).
defect: Stratum matched on cand_red and dH but NOT on target. Conditioning on dH -- a POST-TREATMENT variable -- acted as a one-sided target filter, removing all 400 target-2 relevant trials.
post_fix_method: paired within target; balanced 400 per arm per target by construction; no post-treatment conditioning
why_original_failed: The estimate was computed correctly but from an unbalanced subset, and labelling it 'matched-strata' implied control over candidate structure that had not been achieved.
what_remains_valid: Relevance predicts accuracy. All three targets show positive gaps independently (+0.6400, +0.6575, +0.4375).
must_no_longer_claim: matching cand_red and dH is sufficient matching
